text: {"casual": "Harbour Athletic took control of the game around the 65th minute, changing the flow and putting Northgate on the back foot.", "analyst": "At 65', Harbour Athletic boosted their momentum to 77, up from 7, by increasing possession from 36% to 49%, elevating pressures from 5 to 12, and improving control-vs-chaos from 24 to 35 over the last 5 minutes, disrupting Northgate's earlier dominance marked by 93 momentum and high pass accuracy.", "player": "Despite my 80% passing accuracy over 103 passes and covering 7.43 km, Harbour Athletic's surge around the 65th minute brought momentum down to 23, as they pressed harder and gained the upper hand.", "es": "Harbour Athletic tomó el control del partido cerca del minuto 65, cambiando el ritmo y poniendo a Northgate en dificultad."}
